reviews.title: Awesomeness app ever

I’ve recommended this app to many of my close friends & family members and they all agree that this is the best app ever. I also recommend that everyone who reads this review go ahead & download the app for yourselves. I promise you will also be positively impressed just as much as I am. The app is very easy to use & the points accumulate fast. When I’m ready to withdraw my points the gift rewards are sent to my email quickly leaving me feeling very excited to have received my gift rewards. When I needed some assistance Jasmine, & Janella, from ReceiptJar Support we’re both a great help to me & these support agents responded quickly answering all of my questions. They both helped resolve the issue and I was left very satisfied with both of their professional support. 5stars review isn’t enough if I could give a much more higher star🌟rating I would be honored to give it to ReceiptJar, because this app really deserves it.🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 Thanks ReceiptJar, From app member Mirta N.

My email has always been attached and once my account was shut off and I tried to reach out to them. They responded one time and after I requested that my account be reinstated because I had a $50 credit on it they stopped responding to me. I sent 22 emails asking for help and not a single email was responded to other than that very first one. I did email again from a different email address and I got a very quick response and they asked how I can help but they didn’t have that email on file. I gave them the email of the account and again all responses stopped. I acquired at least $50 in scanning my receipts and now they are keeping that and will not respond to any of my emails to reinstate my account. So my advice is once you get enough receipts to cash out money, be sure to cash out your money as soon as possible or they will just keep it. UPDATE: They have since emailed me asking me to email them in regards to this to get my account reinstated. And just as before, no one is emailing me back again about this. My emails are being read (I use an email tracker,) and I can see that they are being read and ignored. So they still have my $ from inaccurately deactivating my account (I uploaded weekly so it’s not an issue of not uploading) and I doubt I will ever see it. Use Recipt Hog or Fetch instead. They don’t steal your money.

reviews.title: Terrible Costumer Service and suspended account if you start earning too much.
reviews.text: I am extremely disappointed with this app. I used ReceiptJar for over a year, during which they collected my receipt and shopping data with no issues. At first, progress was slow but consistent. As my level increased, I began earning points faster, my golden jar was worth about 375 points, which made it possible to redeem rewards more easily.I had previously redeem around 50 dollars in the year. I tried to redeem a $10 reward, my account was suspended two days later for allegedly having “multiple accounts,” which is completely false. I do not have multiple accounts. What is most frustrating is that after collecting my data for so long, as soon as earning became faster and rewards were easier to reach, my account was suddenly blocked so I could no longer redeem anything. I contacted customer support multiple times to explain that this must be an error, but instead of reviewing my case or providing any explanation, they sent the same copy-and-paste response repeating the accusation. This feels extremely unfair and suspicious. The lack of transparency and unwillingness to properly investigate makes this app impossible to trust. I would not longer recommend ReceiptJar to anyone.

reviews.title: Stay Away! They’ll close your account without warning!
reviews.text: To the Receipt Jar team, Just wanted to extend a sincere thank you for the masterclass in how to lose customer trust in one simple move. Deactivating my account due to so-called “inactivity,” with zero warning, zero grace period, and no option for appeal or recovery, is bold. Not the good kind of bold — the “we don’t actually value our users” kind. But hey, I’m sure pocketing the leftover balances from people who had the nerve to take a break from uploading receipts is a fantastic business model. Real sustainable stuff. I used your app. I supported your platform. I played by the rules. And now, because I wasn’t consistently feeding you data for a stretch of time, you’ve wiped my account and kept the money I rightfully earned. That’s not just disappointing — it’s predatory. You call it “policy.” I call it a convenient way to clean out balances and pretend it’s about engagement. If your idea of customer service is locking people out of what they earned without a single email notice or attempt at reactivation, you might want to reassess the kind of reputation you’re building. But no worries. You’ve saved me from ever wasting another minute (or receipt) on your platform again. I’ll be sure to spread the word about how Receipt Jar treats its users — especially the ones who step away briefly and come back to find their earnings conveniently erased. Enjoy the couple bucks you took from my account. Clearly, you needed them more than I did.
